baseline.architecture: Zero-build Vanilla ES Modules frontend, Express 5 / Node.js LTS backend, MongoDB multi-document transactions

milestones.title: Global System Audit & Baseline Discovery
milestones.findings: Complete inventory of 16 modules, 25 screens, 248 controls; zero baseline leakage; established P0-P3 defect taxonomy.

milestones.title: P0 Critical Remediation
milestones.findings: Eliminated critical auth boundary gaps, enforced brute-force PIN rate limits, isolated CORS origins, purged hardcoded dev secrets.

milestones.title: P1 Functional Integrity & Transaction Atomicity
milestones.findings: Atomic MongoDB session transactions for bill settlement, stock deduction, cash book immutable entries, and biometric shift pairing.

milestones.title: Full Wiring & Freeze Readiness
milestones.findings: 100% frontend-to-backend API wiring across all 25 screens; strict role-based route guard enforcement; zero broken routes.

milestones.title: Final Release Validation & Code Freeze
milestones.findings: Comprehensive regression pass with 0 failures; certified core business operations; locked master baseline.

milestones.title: Recommended Hardening Specifications
milestones.findings: Identified operational hardening recommendations for ASVS 5.0, STRIDE threat models, UAT scenarios, and DR procedures.

milestones.title: Code-First Hardening Implementation
milestones.findings: Replaced markdown-only documentation with executable code: ASVS test suite (backend/test/asvsCompliance.test.js), STRIDE abuse tests (backend/test/threatModelAbuseCases.test.js), UAT E2E tests (backend/test/cafeOperationsUatE2E.test.js), Export engine tests (backend/test/exportEngineCompliance.test.js), Data classifier (backend/src/utils/dataClassifier.js), Mongo DR tool (scripts/mongo_dr_tool.mjs), Rollback manager (scripts/rollback_manager.mjs), Incident triage CLI (scripts/incident_triage_cli.mjs), and Deployment readiness checker (scripts/check_deploy_readiness.mjs).

milestones.title: Employee & Staff Management Module Final Freeze
milestones.findings: Finalized staff lifecycle, dual-PIN security, biometric clock-in, and shift scheduling.

milestones.title: Owner Portal & Executive Management Track
milestones.sharedModules: Certified multi-tenant boundary, branding provider, and immutable ledger.
